guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile build fails with error: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11" and similarly for python3.11-venv and python3.11-distutils. This indicates that the base Ubuntu 20.04 repositories do not have these Python 3.11 packages available by default. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to add the deadsnakes PPA, which provides newer Python versions for Ubuntu 20.04. Specifically, before installing Python packages, run:

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y software-properties-common \
    && add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y python3.11 python3.11-venv python3.11-distutils ...

This will allow installation of Python 3.11 and its related packages. Keep other installation steps as is after this fix.
